label: Wudang Swordswoman
overflowParts: the sword blade, the sword tassel or the wide sleeves
description: a graceful young Wudang swordswoman: long black hair in a high bun held by a jade hairpin with a few loose strands, a calm determined face, a white and pale-blue Taoist robe with wide flowing sleeves and a blue sash belt, white trousers, black cloth shoes, holding a straight double-edged jian sword with a silver blade and a long blue tassel on the hilt

portrait.prompt: Now something different: NOT a sprite sheet. Draw ONE single square character-select portrait (one image, no grid, no frames) of the same character ({description}), in the same pixel-art style but more detailed: chest-up close-up, the face large with a calm, piercing gaze, the jian sword held upright beside the face with its blade catching the light and the blue tassel flowing, the head turned three-quarters toward the left, dramatic rim lighting. Solid misty pale blue mountains at dawn background with a subtle pixel texture, no other characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no frame.

actions.label: Idle
actions.note: A light, flowing tai chi sword fighting stance. The feet stay in the same place in every frame; only the body bobs and breathes.
poses: rest pose in the guard stance
body dips about 2 pixels, shoulders relax
returning to the rest pose, very close to frame 1 so the loop is seamless

actions.label: Walk Forward
actions.note: A guarded step toward the LEFT. The character stays centred in its cell (walking in place).
poses: contact: front (left) foot stepping forward, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Walk Backward
actions.note: A retreating step: still FACING LEFT toward the enemy, guard up, stepping backward (to the right). The character stays centred in its cell.
poses: contact: back (right) foot placed behind, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Crouch
actions.note: Six clearly DIFFERENT poses going from standing down to kneeling; the feet stay on the same ground line.
poses: standing guard stance exactly as in the reference, full height
half squat, knees bent, head clearly lower than in frame 1
dropping to one knee, the back knee almost touching the ground
kneeling on one knee, guard up, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Jump
actions.note: The ground line is at the same height in every frame. Frames 1 and 6 have the feet on the ground line; in frames 3, 4 and 5 the whole character is drawn clearly above the ground line. Keep the character horizontally centred in its cell.
poses: anticipation: deep crouch, feet on the ground line
launch: legs extending, feet leaving the ground
rising: whole body above the ground line, knees tucked
landing: feet back on the ground line, knees bent absorbing the impact

actions.label: Block High
actions.note: Feet stay planted. The block pose is held from frame 3 onward.
poses: guard stance, starting to raise the guard
the sword held flat and horizontal in front of the face
block held: the sword held flat and horizontal in front of the face and chest, body braced

actions.label: Block Low
actions.note: Feet stay on the ground line. Goes from standing to a LOW crouching block held from frame 3 onward.
poses: crouching low, the guard lowering in front of the knees
block held: deep low crouch kneeling on one knee, guarding the shins, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Hit High
actions.note: Struck in the face from the LEFT, recoiling backward to the RIGHT; feet stay near the ground line.
poses: impact: head snaps back, eyes shut
maximum recoil: torso bent far back, one foot sliding
back in the guard stance with a pained face

actions.label: Swift Thrust
actions.note: A fast straight sword thrust toward the LEFT at chest height, the arm and blade fully extended. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: strike: the sword thrust straight forward to the LEFT at chest height
full extension: the sword thrust straight forward to the LEFT at chest height, a short white impact streak touching it

actions.label: Low Sweep Cut
actions.note: A wide low sword slash along the ground toward the LEFT, aimed at the shins, the body crouched low. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: wind-up, body turning, the attack chambered
strike: the sword slashing low to the LEFT just above the ground, a motion arc touching it
full extension: the sword slashing low to the LEFT just above the ground

actions.label: Cloud Breath
actions.note: Powering up in place; feet stay planted. White wind ribbons and a pale blue glow swirl around her and along the blade (white and pale blue only). The aura always touches the body (no separate floating sparks).

actions.label: Cloud Hand Sword
actions.note: IMPORTANT: NINE frames in a 3x3 grid (3 columns and 3 ROWS). A three-hit combo toward the LEFT. The strike frames are 3, 5 and 7; frames 4, 6 and 8 are transitions. White wind ribbons and pale blue light trail the sword (white and pale blue only). Effects always touch the fighter or weapon.
poses: first hit: a rising diagonal sword slash with a white wind trail toward the LEFT
second hit: a spinning horizontal sword slash with a pale blue arc toward the LEFT
third hit, the finisher: a lunging sword thrust releasing a large spiral of white wind toward the LEFT, a large burst

actions.label: Knockdown
actions.note: Hit from the LEFT, falling backward to the RIGHT, ending lying on the back with the head to the right and the feet to the left. The lying body must fit inside its cell.
poses: hitting the ground on the back, small dust puff touching the body
lying flat, head to the right, feet to the left
